question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become a durable public plugin SDK contract, or should this signal remain behind a narrower internal or plugin-owned boundary?
rationale: The PR adds externally consumable API to solve a bundled Codex-to-Slack bug, so maintainer intent is required before accepting that compatibility surface.

options.title: Accept the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the constant and predicate after fixing Slack delivery, treating generic tool-progress intent as supported third-party plugin API.

options.title: Keep the signal private
options.body: Replace the public exports with a narrower existing boundary if generic external plugin use is not intended.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the constant and predicate after fixing Slack delivery, treating generic tool-progress intent as supported third-party plugin API.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current cross-surface progress and Slack delivery architecture through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104770.
